2007.seasonNote: Made his professional debut on the PGA TOUR at The Open Championship, finishing T42.

2009.seasonNote: Recorded six top-20 finishes, including T3 at the PGA Championship and runner-up at the OMEGA Mission Hills World Cup.

events.tournament: World Golf Championships-Accenture Match Play Championship

2010.seasonNote: Earned his first PGA TOUR victory at the Quail Hollow Championship and posted top-3 finishes in both The Open Championship and PGA Championship.

events.tournament: World Golf Championships-Accenture Match Play Championship

2011.seasonNote: Captured his first major championship at the U.S. Open with a record-setting 16-under performance. Added five other top-10 finishes worldwide, including fifth at the Memorial Tournament and T4 finishes at both the HSBC Champions and OMEGA Mission Hills World Cup.

events.tournament: World Golf Championships-Accenture Match Play Championship
the Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide Insurance

2012.seasonNote: Won three times, including his second major at the PGA Championship and back-to-back FedExCup Playoff victories at the Deutsche Bank Championship and BMW Championship. Finished second in the FedExCup standings and recorded six top-10 finishes.

events.tournament: the Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide Insurance

2013.seasonNote: A winless season highlighted by runner-up finishes at the Valero Texas Open and several top-10s, including THE PLAYERS Championship, the PGA Championship, and two World Golf Championships events. Struggled in the majors, missing the cut at The Open Championship and finishing outside the top 25 in the other three.

events.tournament: World Golf Championships-Accenture Match Play Championship
the Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide Insurance

2013-2014.seasonNote: One of the best seasons of McIlroy's career. Won The Open Championship, the WGC-Bridgestone Invitational, and the PGA Championship in consecutive starts, then capped the year with runner-up finishes in the FedExCup Playoffs to finish atop the FedExCup standings.

events.tournament: World Golf Championships-Accenture Match Play Championship
the Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide Insurance

2014-2015.seasonNote: Won the WGC-Cadillac Match Play and Wells Fargo Championship while recording seven top-10 finishes in 12 starts. Finished the season with top-10s at the Masters, U.S. Open, BMW Championship, and multiple World Golf Championships events.

events.tournament: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by MasterCard

2015-2016.seasonNote: Won the Deutsche Bank Championship and TOUR Championship during a late-season surge that secured the FedExCup. Recorded eight top-10 finishes, including third at the WGC-Cadillac Championship and top-5 finishes at the Masters, Wells Fargo Championship, Memorial Tournament, Open Championship, and BMW Championship.

events.tournament: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by MasterCard
the Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide

2017-2018.seasonNote: Won the Arnold Palmer Invitational and added a runner-up finish at The Open Championship. Posted seven top-10 finishes and 11 top-25 finishes in 18 official starts.

events.tournament: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard
World Golf Championships-Dell Technologies Match Play

2018-2019.seasonNote: Won THE PLAYERS Championship, the RBC Canadian Open and the TOUR Championship, finishing No. 1 in the FedExCup standings. Recorded 14 top-10 finishes and eight top-5 finishes in 19 official starts.

events.tournament: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard

2019-2020.seasonNote: Won the WGC-HSBC Champions and recorded six top-5 finishes. Finished eighth in the FedExCup despite the season interruption and schedule changes caused by COVID-19.

events.tournament: Arnold Palmer Invitational presented by Mastercard
the Memorial Tournament presented by Nationwide

2020-2021.seasonNote: Won the Wells Fargo Championship for a third time and recorded seven top-10 finishes. Struggled in the majors with missed cuts at the Masters and Players but still finished 15th in the FedExCup standings.

2021-2022.seasonNote: Won the CJ Cup, RBC Canadian Open, and TOUR Championship while reclaiming the FedExCup title. Added runner-up finishes at the Masters and The Open Championship, recording one of the strongest seasons of his career.

2022-2023.seasonNote: Won the CJ Cup and Genesis Scottish Open while posting runner-up finishes at the Arnold Palmer Invitational and U.S. Open. Recorded 13 top-10 finishes and finished fourth in the FedExCup standings.
